Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Music Samini establishes independent music imprint in global partnership with DogSled Music Group Source : Amelley Djosu 16 November 2026 5:17pm ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
Ghanaian reggae-dancehall musician Samini is expanding his business interests with the establishment of an independent music imprint, Samini Music, through a partnership with international music and entertainment company DogSled Music Group (DMG).
Announced on November 9, 2026, the partnership will see Samini establish and operate the imprint under the DogSled Music Group umbrella, creating a platform for his music, business interests and future artist development plans.
The venture is expected to extend beyond music releases into publishing, synchronisation licensing and talent development, while providing opportunities for emerging artistes from Ghana and other parts of Africa. Empire Distribution is also named as part of the arrangement, alongside Ghanaian entertainment partner Jungle House Events.
The move marks a new phase in Samini’s career, positioning him not only as a recording and performing artiste but also as an entrepreneur with interests in developing talent and building a wider entertainment business.
DogSled Music Group was founded by Veda Smith, an Emmy Award-winning and Grammy-nominated producer and music executive. The company operates across music, television, film, digital distribution, licensing, publishing, marketing and international entertainment partnerships.
Commenting on the partnership, Smith said the objective was to help Samini build on his established music career by providing the resources, industry infrastructure and international connections needed to develop an independent entertainment enterprise.
She explained: "This partnership is about building beyond the music. Samini has already established an incredible legacy and international following. Our vision is to provide the business infrastructure, resources and global connections that allow him to expand that legacy into an independent entertainment enterprise. We want to create opportunities for established artists to become owners, executives and mentors who can build platforms for the next generation."
International expansion is another key element of the arrangement. The announcement identifies DogSled African Radio, an iHeartRadio-affiliated platform, as one of the channels through which Samini Music could reach audiences in Ghana, Nigeria, Trinidad and Tobago, Germany, South Africa, Jamaica and other markets.
The partnership is also expected to facilitate international radio exposure, digital distribution, promotional campaigns, audiovisual content, licensing opportunities and strategic brand collaborations.
For Samini, the imprint provides a framework to deepen his involvement in the business and creative sides of the music industry while potentially opening doors for younger African artistes seeking professional guidance and access to international networks.
Attention will now turn to how the partnership translates its ambitions into music releases, artist development, business ventures and opportunities for African talent to reach wider audiences.
